jobs.title: PRODUCT Product Builder Norwich
jobs.description: Product Builder Product Norwich Refer a friend Description Artlist is a leading creative technology company on a mission to empower creators and brands to bring their vision to life with video. Offering cutting-edge AI tools and models for image, video, and voiceover creation, alongside high-quality creative assets and powerful editing tools, Artlist enables creators to stay on trend and achieve their creative goals. Trusted by over 30 million creators worldwide and top brands including Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Versace, Artlist provides a seamless, subscription-based platform with a global license, giving creators everything they need to produce professional video content efficiently. For more information, visit artlist.io. Artlist's core Gen AI product puts state-of-the-art generative models for image, video, and voiceover directly in creators' hands, giving them total creative control over every stage of production. It is our flagship offering and a core pillar of our innovation strategy. As a Product Builder on our core Gen AI product, you will define and ship the future of video production for millions of creators interacting with generative AI. A Product Builder is not a traditional product manager who hands off requirements; a Product Builder makes. You take end-to-end ownership of a defined product area and turn ideas into shipped product, working hands-on inside a small, fast-moving pod. Your core deliverable is the Definition of Ready (DoR): a working prototype, the data events and success metrics to instrument, and a tight, operational spec that engineers and AI agents can build from directly. This replaces the old cycle of long PRDs and Figma wireframes recreated by hand. You decide what to build, how it will behave, and how we will know it worked, before a line of code is written. This role requires translating evolving AI model capabilities into intuitive, high-quality user experiences. You will balance user needs, technical constraints, and business goals to scale and evolve the product's capabilities, and drive measurable impact on key engagement and retention metrics. Requirements Hands-on experience as a video creator or AI video creator, with a strong body of work and high creative taste. Deep, first-hand understanding of creator workflows and where current Gen AI tools fall short. Strong product sense: able to turn a problem into a Definition of Ready - a working prototype, the data events and success metrics, and a clear, buildable spec. Sharp UI/UX intuition - you simplify complex systems into intuitive experiences. Analytical and data-driven, comfortable defining the metrics that prove impact. Hands-on with modern AI tooling to prototype and build, with a bias to ship and iterate. Excellent communication and the ability to align cross-functional stakeholders. Nice to Have: Proven experience working on generative AI products. Product management experience or experience working with agile development teams. Proven experience in the SaaS industry. jobs.description: Senior Backend Developer R&D Tel Aviv-Yafo Refer a friend Description Artlist is a leading creative technology company on a mission to empower creators and brands to bring their vision to life with video. Offering cutting-edge AI tools and models for image, video, and voiceover creation, alongside high-quality creative assets and powerful editing tools, Artlist enables creators to stay on trend, and achieve their creative goals. Trusted by over 30 million creators worldwide and top brands including Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Versace, Artlist provides a seamless, subscription-based platform with a global license, giving creators everything they need to produce professional video content efficiently. For more information, visit artlist.io. Artlist is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our new Platform Infrastructure team. In this foundational role, you’ll help build the shared backend systems, frameworks, and tooling that power every product across the company. If you’re passionate about solving hard technical problems, shaping internal architecture, and scaling best practices across teams - we want to hear from you. Wake Up for This Build for builders: Design and develop the backend infrastructure that other teams will rely on- from shared services and APIs to internal developer tools and performance optimizations. Engineer at scale: Work across modern backend stacks, building reusable systems that balance flexibility with consistency. Drive technical standards: Partner with tech leads, designers, and developers across the company to define best practices and guide architectural decisions. Lead by example: Mentor other engineers, support their growth, and help raise the overall bar for backend quality and maintainability. Create real impact: Your work will improve development velocity, code quality, and user experience for millions of creators and countless internal users. Requirements 6+ years of professional experience in backend development. At least 2 years of hands-on experience with Node.js in a production environment. Proven experience designing or maintaining shared backend systems (e.g., internal tooling, platform-level services, microservices, or APIs). Strong understanding of complex system design and application architecture — multiple services, offline processes, queues and topics, scale, performance, and error handling — backed by strong problem-solving skills, a solid investigation methodology, and an algorithmic mindset. Hands-on experience with cloud environments — AWS or equivalent (e.g., GCP, Azure) — including deploying, managing, and scaling backend services. Experience across a range of databases (SQL, NoSQL, key-value, and others), including designing schemas, optimizing queries, and ensuring data integrity. Experience working on internal platforms or infrastructure initiatives is highly desirable. Demonstrated ownership and ability to lead projects end to end — working both independently and collaboratively with stakeholders, mentoring other engineers, and managing your own priorities and deadlines. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and building for performance, reliability, and security. A passion for clean code and developer experience, an independent and fast-learning mindset, and genuine enthusiasm for leveraging AI in day-to-day work and complex problem solving. By submitting the application, you declare that you and the candidate have reviewed and understood Artlist’s Candidate Privacy Notice.
